title: NBA Fans Let Nasty Jokes Fly at LeBron James as Los Angeles Lakers Lock In for Playoff Prep - NewsBreak
text:
By Kenny Nosay ,
1 hours ago
Rui Hachimura, LeBron James, Deandre Ayton, and Luke Kennard (Photo by @Lakers/X) The Los Angeles Lakers, despite having home-court advantage, are the overwhelming underdogs in their series against the Houston Rockets. But can their secret workout help LeBron James and the rest of the squad prepare for the playoffs?
Austin Reaves is projected to miss the entire first round. He’ll be back – if the LA extends their season – around the first week of May. However, LeBron might have his help, as Luka Doncic could realistically play sooner after returning from Spain for his hamstring treatment.
For now, the Lakers will be spearheaded by LeBron James. And they already have a secret workout for the postseason – going full speed on stationary bikes.
“All gas, no brakes,” per LA’s official account on X.
Based on the short clip, the team looks ready for their battle against Kevin Durant and the Rockets. LeBron will surely have his plate full. At 41, he’ll be tasked to hold down the fort until either Doncic or Reaves comes back.
Fans Had Funny Reactions To LeBron James and LA’s Workout We know teams prepare differently because the playoffs are a different contest than the regular season. And fans on X were amused by LA emphasizing a stationary bike-centered workout for their series against Houston.
“41 yr old out working em all,” a fan said.
“Ain’t too many dudes doin’ this at 41. Love him or hate him, LeBron a straight-up king. Respect,” a fan commented.
“This is corny by the Lakers. I can’t lie,” another fan said.
“is this another devin booker “gotta get this bread” meme b4 playoff disaster????” another fan commented.
“Lebron doing all that to average 18/7/6 on 42% shooting and getting knocked out in 4,” a fan said.
“all of this just to lose to rockets in 5,” another fan commented.
The Lakers better hope their new workout pays off. LeBron James may miss his co-stars , but he’ll have no choice but to perform as he did in his early 30s to give this team a chance in the first round.
